name: Stack-Based Representation (SBR)
definition: Decomposition of a voxel grid V (resolution w × h × d) into a set S of vertical stacks, where each stack Sx,y represents the column of voxels at position xy.
summary: Stack-Based Representation compresses voxel grids into vertical run-length encoded stacks, enabling embarrassingly parallel construction and serving as the foundation for hierarchical variants like QuadStack.
